quests.title: Radiant Harvest: Compensation

dialogue.t: Hey! You're back. You missed out on something hilarious just now!
Just now, I brought the retrieved jellyfish and waited here for Mr. Augereau's inspection. But before he could show up, some of my buyers did.

They told me that ever since releasing the first several batches of jellyfish, they felt refreshed, and their business has been going super well. They thought it must have been a blessing from the heavens for doing a good deed! So they came back to buy more to release.

dialogue.sit: I'm still trying to catch them for you...
How are you still selling them...

dialogue.t: Hmm... {NICKNAME} catches them, Mr. Kesean sells them, and buyers release them again... Hey! Is this your way of making money!?
What!? No! How could I!? I don't want any more trouble with the Gardes!
Ahem... I spent ages telling them that releasing these jellyfish does more harm than good, but they simply wouldn't listen!
They just believe that their luck was due to... what they consider to be a good deed.
They even believe that my bad luck was due to keeping the jellyfish in captivity. *sigh* Just what are they thinking...
Anyway, while we argued, Mr. Augereau arrived and immediately took them into custody.

dialogue.sit: Guess their luck had run out.

dialogue.t: ...In the end, was carelessly releasing these creatures without first understanding their habits and ecology really for the creatures, or just for their own good luck?
They were also taken into custody by the Gardes... Seems like they didn't get much luck out of it in the end.
Ha! Speaking of which, thanks to you, the Gardes have now waived my jail sentence.
In addition to the compensation I promised you, I also have a little memento for you. Please, take it.

dialogue.sit: Kesean takes out a jellyfish ball...

dialogue.t: Ehh?? Are these... also Violetglow Jellyfish? Why do they look so much smaller than the ones we caught before...

Yep, they are smaller specimens. I picked out a few suitable specimens from the storage warehouse yesterday. There were more specimens than there were assignment numbers, though, so I figured I might as well give you some as a memento.
As for the rest, I'll continue breeding them and find a way to integrate them into natural environments.
Oh, and I'm also planning on keeping a few of the Violetglow Jellyfish to investigate their clustering and glowing behavior.

dialogue.sit: Well, they do look pretty cute...
I think they would look cuter swimming in the water...

dialogue.t: W—Woah, wait! Don't you dare to think about releasing them!!!

quests.description: The deadline for retrieving the Violetglow Jellyfish is nearing. It’s time to check in on how Kesean’s doing…
